<p class="xmsonormal">
	At the time of the inspection, the business was experiencing an unexpected and significant disruption to its management structure.&nbsp; This resulted in an immediate gap in management oversight and, regrettably, a number of food safety management and record-keeping procedures were not being maintained to the standard we expect.&nbsp; Within 48 hours of the inspection, we submitted a formal application for a re-rating inspection, reflecting both the speed with which corrective action was taken and our confidence that the required standards are now being met.</p>
